purpose: Each mutant is a minimal self-contained fixture (a seeded issue_v1 `stream` + the `corrupted` served/suppressed/excluded_security partition a BUGGY impl would emit, breaking ONE privacy invariant). `bin/falsify issue-collection` runs the gate against golden (expect PASS — the merged impl equals the independent reference) then every mutant (expect REJECT — the gate recomputes the CORRECT partition from the stream via the independent reference and diffs it against `corrupted`). Falsifiability score = mutants rejected / total, conditioned on golden passing; a P0 gate requires 1.0. A mutant that SURVIVES (gate stays green) proves the normalization is blind to that defect class and is a false-green — it BLOCKS the build.

mutants.name: kanon-off
mutants.defect: a signature bucket seen by only 4 distinct teams (< ISSUE_K_ANONYMITY_MIN=10) is SERVED with real rates instead of SUPPRESSED — the k-anon floor is off
mutants.reject_contract: served/suppressed partition diverges: the reference suppresses the 4-team bucket; the corrupted impl serves it (served index 0: reference [] vs corrupted [4-team bucket])

mutants.name: security-lane-leak
mutants.defect: a security-sensitive bucket (error_class=auth, security_sensitive=true) enters the PUBLIC served aggregate instead of being excluded to the private lane — the absolute security exclusion (INV-F, any k) is broken
mutants.reject_contract: served set diverges (the corrupted impl serves the auth bucket) AND excluded_security drops from 12 to 0

mutants.name: cross-tenant-merge
mutants.defect: distinct-team count conflated with ROW count: a bucket with 10 distinct teams but 20 rows reports teams=20; a single team spamming issues would then clear k-anon as if it were a real cohort — a cross-tenant merge defeating the distinct-team guarantee
mutants.reject_contract: served bucket diverges at the teams field: reference 10 (distinct) vs corrupted 20 (rows)

mutants.name: wrong-bucket-key
mutants.defect: the bucket key drops signature_hash, so two DISTINCT error signatures collapse into ONE bucket — the published partition hides which signatures exist and inflates a single bucket's counts
mutants.reject_contract: served set diverges: reference has 2 distinct-signature buckets, the corrupted impl has 1 merged bucket with an empty signature_hash (served count 2 vs 1)
